entities.summary: Lily Isabelle Owsley in Bristol, England is an English field hockey player who plays as a midfielder or forward for Argentine club Club Atlético Banco de la Provincia de Buenos Aires and the England and Great Britain national teams. She´s also a big argentine football fan, allegedly a Club Atlético Platense fan
